headline: Future Letters, from entry to detail
overview: Write a letter to your future self and schedule it for delivery via email. Capture your current hopes, fears, and intentions to reconnect with your present mindset at a chosen future date.
targetAudience: Users interested in growth tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Write heartfelt letters to your future self
Schedule email delivery for any future date
Capture current hopes, fears, goals, and intentions
Review previously sent and scheduled letters
tips: Be honest and specific — your future self will appreciate knowing exactly what you were feeling and thinking today.
Try scheduling letters at meaningful milestones: 6 months, 1 year, or at the start of a new chapter in life.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
